name: @fisch0920/bird
description: CLI tool for tweeting and replying via Twitter/X GraphQL API

scripts.build: pnpm run build:dist && pnpm run build:binary
scripts.build:binary: BIRD_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") BIRD_GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short=8 HEAD 2>/dev/null || true) bun build --compile --minify --env=BIRD_* src/cli.ts --outfile bird
scripts.test:live: pnpm run build:dist && BIRD_LIVE=1 vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/live/live.test.ts
scripts.test:live:all: pnpm run build:dist && BIRD_LIVE=1 vitest run --no-file-parallelism tests/live/live-all.test.ts
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:biome && pnpm run lint:oxlint
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run lint:biome:fix && pnpm run lint:oxlint:fix
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build:dist && pnpm test
